requirement.statement: CtrlFlow SHALL expose semantic orchestration primitives rather than raw behavior-tree implementation nodes. The canonical grammar SHALL define Run, If, Require, Fallback, Retry, Timeout, Until, ForEach, Parallel, Race, CallFlow, and Return with explicit data, fault, cancellation, and lifecycle semantics.

case.given: a CtrlFlow product definition contains public Sequence, Selector, or Condition
case.then: the definition SHALL be rejected as internal behavior-tree syntax

case.given: a Parallel definition contains concurrent bodies
case.then: it SHALL own one Lanes child domain rather than reusing If Branches

requirement.statement: Each public orchestration primitive SHALL declare product capability and lifecycle semantics. InstantFlow SHALL reject durable waiting and recovery behavior; WorkFlow and BizProcess SHALL own all facts needed to resume enabled durable primitives; BizProcess human parallelism SHALL remain owned by TaskGroup executionMode.

case.given: an InstantFlow CallFlow targets a suspend-capable product
case.then: validation SHALL reject the synchronous invocation

requirement.statement: InstantFlow, WorkFlow, and BizProcess SHALL each own exactly one FlowContract child domain whose id equals the root FQN and whose optional input/output code type references define the static callable boundary. CallFlow validation SHALL resolve target form, contract, and permitted invocation mode through a registry.

case.then: its id SHALL equal the enclosing flow FQN
